items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: The Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC).

People across India celebrated the Chandrayaan-3 achievement with dancing, waving Indian flags, setting off firecrackers, and playing drums. The image shows people celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3.

items.title: The Internet Is Abuzz With Reactions To Chandrayaan-3’s Successful Moon Landing: Shah Rukh Khan (SRK), Anand Mahindra, Yami Gautam
items.snippet_en: The image shows people celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3. The internet was abuzz with reactions to Chandrayaan-3's successful moon landing.

outputs.notes_en: The claim states that the image shows people in India celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3. Sources 2 and 3 confirm that the image shows people celebrating the successful landing of Chandrayaan-3. Source 1 provides context about the Chandrayaan-3 landing date.
